rotate.name: Rotate personality
rotate.description: Randomly select a different configured personality for new conversations. Target an Assist Voice device, or one of its entities, to rotate only that device; without a target every configured Assist Voice device rotates.

set_personality.name: Set personality
set_personality.description: Select a configured personality for new conversations. Target an Assist Voice device, or one of its entities, to select only that device; without a target the personality is selected on every configured Assist Voice device that offers it.

personality.description: Conversation entity to use for new conversations.
